submission.title: Normalize inbound lead intake for human review via webhook
submission.review_feedback: too basic to meet publishing criteria
submission.reviewer_suggestion: If intended for beginners, consider a YouTube tutorial linked as a sticky note on the canvas.

interpretation.learning: A minimal credential-free normalization/review workflow is insufficiently substantive for n8n template-library publication. Any replacement should add materially deeper reusable automation rather than cosmetic complexity.

next_safe_action: Prepare, but do not submit, a materially deeper replacement candidate using already-verified native Data Table persistent deduplication and explicit human-review boundaries.
authority_effect: NONE; resubmission/publication remains a separate external-action gate.
truth_limit: Template rejection is a distribution-quality signal only; it does not invalidate the internal n8n runtime proof and does not prove market demand, payment or profit.
